changelog:
0.6.1 Every Screen, One System. New warm-brown geometric A icon across all launcher formats. Launch screen removed.

Ava Fleet: one device manages all home terminals. Local network discovery + ADB-connected devices merge into unified device wall. Responsive control-room view with previews, grid/list, search, status overlays. Inspect, control screen, send keys/gestures, shell, logs, mods, Bluetooth, config editor with backup/import/export/templates. Embedded scrcpy for live view, lightweight screenshot for previews. On-device ADB host for wireless debugging. Apps manager, file manager for multi-device access. Path: Settings → Experimental → Cluster Management. Initial password: 1234.

Real Android Desktop: multi-page workspace with drag-and-drop apps and widgets. Free placement, cross-page movement, auto-remove empty pages. Per-orientation layouts. Widget resize, independent geometry per instance. Configurable icon size/shape, third-party packs, wallpaper, lock edits. No dynamic wallpapers or folders.

HA Update entity: reads GitHub releases, detects rebuilt APKs under same version. Downloads via system manager, root/Shizuku auto-install or fallback installer.

VS Wake Word rebuilt: native C++ inference, online catalog, download with progress, immediate activation. microWakeWord dual-stage verification reduces false wakes. Thanks @meiser79 #116.

Bluetooth survives screen-off: adaptive scanning, wake lock, duty-cycling. Shizuku recovery, rooted HCI/MGMT scanner. IRK management sheet with manual paste. Thanks @tar-gezed #112, @ET1963 #122, @rdehuyss.

AirPlay Receiver Mod: audio/video target with pairing, DACP, PIP. Camera Stream Mod: MJPEG/RTSP to Frigate/go2rtc. TTS URL resolution fixed. Screensaver motion probe, Fleet stability, WebView recovery hardened.
